title: Bump base image to node:20
author: saghosh8
description: Upgrades the base image in Dockerfile from node:18-slim to node:20-slim to pick up the latest LTS. package-lock.json was not regenerated in this PR — follow-up planned if any native deps break. Possible impact: the docker build step in deploy.yml could start failing with npm install/engine errors if package-lock.json is not updated to match node:20.
